items.reviewerText: - **CF-LSC2OP-1 (-> LSC-2):** the guest mint, renewal and recovery client consumes LocalSeatRequestError and its code map (LOCAL_SEAT_DENIED 401 vs LOCAL_SEAT_THROTTLED 429 with Retry-After). It must never auto-retry a mint (CF-LSC1-3). It must keep passwords out of state, storage and URLs, with the same T1-style tests.
items.disposition: Retain the reviewer obligation in the receiving unit.

items.reviewerText: - **CF-LSC2OP-2 (-> LSC-2/LSC-2P):** give re-provision of an active seat a distinct label or confirmation (F4). The three-identity proof must show re-provision, then the new playerId, then GM readmission, then ghost membership retained until removal.
items.disposition: Retain the reviewer obligation in the receiving unit.

items.reviewerText: - **CF-LSC2OP-3 (-> server follow-up, outside LSC-2OP ownership):** the repository reports generation-conflict for "not revocable" (unprovisioned or already revoked). Consider a distinct code, so clients need not infer it from status.
items.disposition: No registered server-follow-up unit was named by the ruling; Root retains registration responsibility. This closure grants no server source scope.

items.reviewerText: - **CF-LSC2OP-4 (-> LSC-2P):** verify password-manager and autofill behaviour on the packaged browser, using current-password/new-password (F5), if F5 is not done in-PR.
items.disposition: F5 autocomplete purposes fixed in-PR; packaged password-manager/autofill verification remains LSC-2P.

items.reviewerText: - **CF-LSC2OP-5 (-> Root):** register the salvage successor now: the seven leaves, its own caps, and the 12/12 predicate transferred from LSC-2OP. It runs in parallel with LSC-2 and gates v2.2.0 unless the owner waives it.
items.status: registered; repair and12/12 proof remain open
items.disposition: #2310 registered LSC-SALVAGE-1; preserve its state and recorded release policy. No salvage repair or browser PASS claimed.
